title: Original collages / Maritime seasons and food

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Compare seasonal and cultural subjects so the illustration family can express variety without changing its visual grammar.
strategic_value: Summer, winter and food scenes can extend Helsinki’s familiar character across different messages.
demonstration: Three portrait sheets combine maritime activities, winter scenes and food culture on a shared pale-blue surround.
practical_value: Select a complete collage by its subject and season while retaining the series’ common drawing style.

content_islands.name: Season and food comparison
content_islands.spec: Place the three original sheets in a single row with matching scale and margins.
